strings.check_nosize: Unable to determine index size on Solr server
strings.connectionerror: The specified Solr server is not available or the specified index does not exist
strings.errorsolr: The Solr search engine reported an error: {$a}
strings.errorvalidatingschema: Error validating Solr schema: field {$a->fieldname} does not exist. Please follow this link to set up the required fields.

strings.fileindexing_help:
If your Solr install supports it, this feature allows Moodle to send files to be indexed.
You will need to reindex all site contents after enabling this option for all files to be added.
strings.indexsize: The index is using {$a} on the Solr server.
strings.indexsizelimit_desc: Shows an error on the status report page if the search index grows larger than this size (in bytes), and a warning if it exceeds 90%. Set to zero for no index size limit.
strings.maxindexfilekb_help: Files larger than this number of kilobytes will not be included in search indexing. If set to zero, files of any size will be indexed.
strings.minimumsolr4: Solr 4.0 is the minimum version required for Moodle
strings.missingconfig: Your Apache Solr server is not yet configured in Moodle.
strings.multivaluedfield: Field "{$a}" returned an array instead of a scalar. Please delete the current index, create a new one and run setup_schema.php before indexing data in Solr.
strings.privacy:metadata: This plugin sends data externally to a linked Solr search engine. It does not store data locally.
strings.privacy:metadata:data: Personal data passed through from the search subsystem.
strings.schemafieldautocreated: Field "{$a}" already exists in Solr schema. You probably forgot to run this script before indexing data and fields were autocreated by Solr. Please delete the current index, create a new one and run setup_schema.php again before indexing data in Solr.
strings.schemasetupfromsolr5: Your Solr server version is lower than 5.0. This script can only set your schema if your Solr version is 5.0 or higher. You need to manually set the fields in your schema according to \search_solr\document::get_default_fields_definition().
strings.searchinfo_help:
The field to be searched may be specified by prefixing the search query with 'title:', 'content:', 'name:', or 'intro:'. For example, searching for 'title:news' would return results with the word 'news' in the title.

Boolean operators ('AND', 'OR', 'NOT') may be used to combine or exclude keywords.

Wildcard characters ('*' or '?' ) may be used to represent characters in the search query.
strings.setupok: The schema is ready to be used.
strings.solrhttpconnectiontimeout_desc: The HTTP connection timeout is the maximum time in seconds allowed for the HTTP data transfer operation.
strings.solrnotselected: Solr engine is not the configured search engine
strings.solrserverhostname_desc: Domain name of the Solr server.
